worldcombat.skill.gyroball.summary: Spin yourself into a heavy steel top and screw the target's speed advantage into its spin, then slam in: the faster the target, the heavier the hit and the bigger the top. A slow body is what turns it into a hammer.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.use.0: One heavy hit when the target is faster than you
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.use.1: Spin up in place at contact range, then slam a short way in
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.use.2: Let the speed gap grow the top on screen
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.description.0: Gyro Ball deals about %1$s damage in one slam; the current load is %2$s (target speed / your speed), and a higher load makes the slam heavier. The target's Defence, type and crits settle on hit.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.description.1: It lunges up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s-block rim radius, and knocks a struck target back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.brace.on: Braced form: heavier (power x1.14, knockback x1.18), but a shorter lunge (x0.86), slower roll (x0.92), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown — for a slow body already in the target's face.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.brace.off: Light-spin form (native): lunges farther, rolls faster and recovers cleanly, at slightly lower single-hit power.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s and the rim radius to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.preference.br: On: higher power and knockback, but a shorter lunge, slower roll, longer wind-up and cooldown — for a slow body already in the target's face. Off (default): light-spin, reaching farther and recovering cleanly at slightly lower power.
worldcombat.skill.gyroball.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Gyro Ball is a short contact move, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
